This image may be reduced in size from the original. Click on the image to view full size photo.

This photo of the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station is updated every 15 minutes (if a relay satellite is available for transmission). The camera is located on the roof of the National Science Foundation's Atmospheric Research Observatory (ARO), which houses NOAA/GML's Clean Air Facility.

View of the ARO looking from the signs on the path to the South Pole Station.
